description: ESG investing evaluated on the Triple Bottom Line it's actually built on (People, Planet, Profit — Elkington, 1994), not financial return alone — why ratings diverge across providers, real fee/cost/performance data (including a genuinely improving financial-return trend since 2019), systematic greenwashing detection, and a balanced, two-sided account of what the peer-reviewed literature does and doesn't yet settle.
name: esg.deep_dive_track
title: ESG Deep Dive Track
